description:
Kaito Itokazu left his home in Los Angeles to start a new career in Japan. The 27-year-old software engineer brings in $90,000 a year between his work as a salaryman and side gigs. But even when living in an upscale Tokyo neighborhood, that income can stretch much farther than it would back home.

In this episode of "The Pay Check," Kaito breaks down his cost of living, sharing exactly how he earns, spends, budgets, and invests his money.

Watch our complete collection of The Pay Check videos: https://bit.ly/4f8lMhh
